question: Can a transported guided packet change a prepared local clock into a distinct autonomous retained record, using the unchanged six-port Rule3 board?
status: Frozen before all trajectories in this family

preparation.packet: Existing GuidedPacketSource, all four core sites and complete transverse remainder halo, on a periodic (0,4) guide.
preparation.clock_channel: ports[+Y][guide_target_channel] at (64,65,64), so reciprocity connects it to the selected guide channel at (64,64,64).
preparation.base_clock_counters: (a,b)=(0,+1) for guide channel0; (0,-1) for guide channel14.
preparation.base_halo: The guide-facing halo keeps its guide remainder0 or4; the other five halo remainders are2. Initial full clock phases are obtained by the algebraic four-cycle, including every halo remainder. The guide-facing sequence is0,2,2,0,0 or4,2,2,4,4. These are explicit joint initial assignments, not an overwrite of assembled patches.
preparation.guide: All untouched guide addresses retain remainder pair(0,4). Packet sockets exclude its four paired core addresses.
preparation.control_matching: At each geometry and phase all controls have identical remainders and guide preparation. Packet-off removes only the recipe's initial packet counters; clock-off removes only the designated center clock counters.

stages.name: compensation
stages.patch: Change exactly one non-guide clock halo base remainder from2 to0 before phase preparation. This preserves the clock-only four-cycle. The changed halo can route feedback only through the original six ports.

readouts.region: All48 channels of the clock center and its six face-neighbor nodes:336 retained triples, with every boundary incoming term computed separately from internal center-halo terms. Center R, center inputs and center C signatures refer to the designated clock channel; every other center-node channel remains part of the complete336-triple checks and all-world C trace.
readouts.all_C: Record every existing C0/C1/C2 event on the complete board for every update. Do not use C classification to update state.
readouts.controlled_activation: A joint center C signature(kind,ell) has greater multiplicity over the entire40-update horizon than in both singleton controls combined, and the joint center counters differ from10+01-00 at some state. A time shift of otherwise identical singleton events is not activation under this definition.
readouts.autonomous_boundary: Every external signed incoming term to every channel of the336-channel region is zero during all8 hold updates. Net cancellation alone does not meet this isolation requirement.
readouts.retained_orbit_family: During9 consecutive states the center has constant R=(a*a+b*b,r), with I in{1,2,4} and even r; every other channel in the336-channel region has zero counters. The entire336-channel state repeats after4 updates wherever both states are inside the hold window. R differs from both singleton control readouts at every corresponding hold state. The actual center input is zero throughout all8 hold updates. This is an exact finite local orbit record, not physical energy or a capture/release proof.
readouts.quiet_record_family: All336 counters are zero and all336 triples remain identical throughout9 states; center r differs from its initial r and its value in both singleton controls at every hold state; the same external-input isolation condition holds.
readouts.outgoing_carrier: At either predeclared outlet, compare all48 channels in the6x3x3 surrounding box to the complete GuidedPacketSource plus uniform guide template for4 consecutive states translating at speed+1 or-1. The backward template is T(a,b,r)=(-b,-a,r), including every halo, on the same(0,4) guide. Count complete matches at start states18..37. Matching local carriers are output transport only; they are not called release of stored information.
readouts.release: Not established by this one-packet/clock experiment. A release component needs a subsequent frozen interrogation/control experiment and evidence linking the stored payload to the output.

baseline_checks: Every01 complete state must repeat after4 updates; every00 state is static; all masks preserve identical full initial remainders. Check exact packet translation before approach in an independent pristine-guide mathematical/test fixture, not by deleting the clock during a run.
no_wrap: All initially nonzero counters have distance at least40 from every periodic boundary. Verify no active counter touches a boundary in any recorded state.
retention: Prefer every complete gzip recording. If the600CPU-second or20MiB recorded-data budget would be exceeded, stop at a complete four-control group, retain all completed groups and all candidate parameters, and mark remaining cases not-run-budget. No positive result may omit a control or its full state. Independent fallback audit selection, if separately needed, is the lexicographically first two geometries per stage across all4phases and4controls, plus all claimed-positive groups.
presenter_selection: Prospectively select all four controls for base/g0/r2/phase0 and compensation/direction2/g0/r2/phase0. If a selected case is not run because of budget, report its omission explicitly rather than substituting an outcome-chosen example.
failure: A changed joint state, transient C, clock growth, local periodicity with external driving, or an outgoing packet without retained payload is conditional interaction only. No readout is revised after outcomes.
